categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu HitGen focuses on small molecule and nucleic acid new drug discovery and optimization, leveraging four core technology platforms: DNA-encoded library (DEL) technology, fragment-based and structure-based drug design (FBDD/SBDD), oligonucleotide-based drug development platform (OBT), and targeted protein degradation platform (TPD). The company provides new drug R&D services, in-progress project equity transfers, and advances self-developed projects towards clinical stages and eventual market launch. Additional services include chemistry and biology services, and custom drug development projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include DEL technology for ultra-large-scale compound library design, synthesis, and screening; FBDD/SBDD for drug design based on molecular fragments and 3D structural information; OBT platform for oligonucleotide drug design, synthesis, modification, and evaluation; and TPD platform focusing on E3 ubiquitin ligase ligand discovery and PROTAC/molecular glue drug development. They integrate AI-driven drug design (AIDD) and automated DMTA (Design-Synthesis-Test-Analysis) cycles to accelerate compound optimization and drug discovery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, chemical companies, foundations, and research institutions. The company collaborates with major international pharma such as Pfizer, AstraZeneca, Bristol-Myers Squibb, Johnson & Johnson, Merck, and Roche. Markets served include early-stage drug discovery and optimization services, with customers primarily in North America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in China, the United States, the United Kingdom, and other international markets. It has subsidiaries and operations in Chengdu, Shanghai, Hong Kong, the UK, and the US, serving clients worldwide. Overseas revenue accounts for a substantial portion of total income, reflecting strong international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu HitGen operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on early drug discovery and development services. It provides compound libraries, screening, and optimization services, as well as proprietary drug candidates progressing through clinical trials. The company also offers CDMO services for oligonucleotide raw materials, positioning itself as a key R&D service provider rather than a downstream manufacturer or distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation and upgrading of its core platforms, especially expanding and optimizing its DEL libraries and integrating AI and automation for drug design and optimization. It focuses on expanding molecular diversity, improving screening success rates, and developing new molecule types such as macrocycles, peptides, covalent compounds, and protein degraders. Strategic R&D also includes advancing self-developed drug candidates through clinical phases and building a global collaborative ecosystem, including the formation of a DEL alliance with major pharma companies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through new drug R&D services including fee-for-service (FFS), full-time equivalent (FTE) service contracts, licensing fees, milestone payments from IP transfers, and equity transfers of in-progress drug projects. The company also earns income from custom chemistry and biology services, CDMO services for nucleic acid drugs, and technology platform access fees such as OpenDEL. Revenue is recognized based on contract progress or upon delivery of services or IP rights.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chengdu HitGen is a leading player in the DEL technology field, recognized as one of the earliest and largest-scale developers in Asia with the world's largest known DNA-encoded small molecule library. It competes with global CROs and biotech firms offering drug discovery services, differentiating itself through its integrated DEL, FBDD/SBDD, OBT, and TPD platforms and strong AI capabilities. The company maintains strong partnerships with top global pharma, reinforcing its competitive position in early drug discovery services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 427 million, a 15% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 51.36 million, up 26%. Total assets reached RMB 1.76 billion, with steady growth in net assets. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and invests about 15.77% of revenue in R&D. Its financial scale reflects a mid-sized, rapidly growing biotech firm with expanding global operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chengdu HitGen offers a unique value proposition through its proprietary ultra-large-scale DEL libraries (over 1.2 trillion compounds), integrated with AI-driven design and automated synthesis/testing platforms, enabling rapid and cost-effective discovery of novel, high-quality lead compounds. Its multi-technology platform approach, including nucleic acid and protein degradation drug discovery, provides diversified and cutting-edge solutions. The company’s strict IP protection, flexible collaboration models, and global partnerships further differentiate it as a trusted innovation engine in early drug discovery.
